match.description: Optional series selectors (match[]): only label names of matching series.

start.description: Start of the window: ISO 8601 with an offset (2026-11-11T09:00:00Z) or relative to now (-1h, now-30m, now). Default: one hour before end.

end.description: End of the window: ISO 8601 with an offset (2026-11-11T09:00:00Z) or relative to now (-1h, now-30m, now). Default: now.

limit.description: Most label names to return; the endpoint caps it.
